root_cause.basis: Pinned runner uses Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0 and Invoke-Js directly reads $r.result.exceptionDetails. Chrome DevTools Protocol defines Runtime.evaluate exceptionDetails as optional, while PowerShell StrictMode 2.0 throws PropertyNotFoundStrict for a missing property. The readiness loop catches and suppresses all exceptions, producing a false not-ready result. Invoke-Cdp also directly reads optional message id and has the same latent strict-mode defect.

repair.strategy: Use PSObject.Properties lookups for optional CDP id and exceptionDetails/value fields; preserve all prior transport, target and output-suppression repairs; preserve raw results _001/_002/_003; write next attempt to _004.

truth_boundary: No Base/B1/B2 generation occurred in v0.6. The strict-mode defect is verified in source and specifications; its causal role in the observed v0.6 readiness failure is high-confidence until v0.7 advances beyond frontend readiness.
